label: the article's water-utility calls
state: Hi, my water was shut off yesterday for repairs on my street, but it still hasn't been turned back on. Can someone come restore my service?

question.instructions: Extract the category of this customer service call to a water utility.

criteria.RESTORE: Water service was shut off (repairs, construction, non-payment) and needs to be turned back on
criteria.ABATEMENT: A property, often vacant or abandoned, with a leak or running water that needs to be stopped
criteria.AMR (METERING): Water meter or automatic meter reading problems: blank display, wrong readings, replacement
criteria.BILLING: Charges, payment, account balance, bill amount disputes, payment plans
criteria.BPCS (BROKEN PIPE): A broken or leaking water main or service pipe, water coming up through the street or ground
criteria.BTR/O (BAD TASTE & ODOR): Water tastes or smells bad: chlorine, rotten eggs, metallic, discolored
criteria.C/I - DEP (CAVE IN/DEPRESSION): A sinkhole, cave-in, or depression in the street or sidewalk
criteria.CEMENT: Restoring pavement, sidewalk, or driveway concrete after utility work
criteria.CHOKED DRAIN: A storm drain, inlet, or catch basin that is clogged and not draining
criteria.CLAIMS: Compensation for damage caused by the utility's work or a water incident
criteria.COMPOST: Compost bins, yard waste, or composting program questions
